## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `97bbc81dfa9eed1f2d56be78796913ccdbefdcd6`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md + scripts/pm/verify-review-tier.mjs, scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs (the `--tier-evidence` refusal and its battery)

Inputs read: card #33605 body and both comments (claim, os-dev-report); PR #33616 body, file list (3 files) and the net diff against `main`; the check-runs on this head. Code outside the diff was read, not reviewed: `record-recognisers.mjs` (`readServedTier`, the record locator), `check-half-states.mjs` (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_HEADING_MARKER`), `label-write.mjs` (its two `judgeBody` calls), `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` (the edit door), `check-self-test-wired.mjs`, `package.json`, `lint.yml`. 66 real sub-agent transcripts in the seat's task folder were read for shape only; the PR's script was not run.

Check-runs at the time of this record: 21 completed with success, the rest skipped by design, and four not finished: `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` (in progress), `Test Core (1/8)` and `(2/8)` (in progress), `TypeScript Type Check` (queued). No red. The verdict below does not rest on them.

### ① Derived judgments

- `post-stamped.mjs --comment` accept set NARROWS: a comment the record locator reads as a record (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_HEADING_MARKER`) whose first `Served-tier:` line reads `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` is refused without passing evidence. Right, and it is the card's item 2. The predicate is the queue guard's own (same marker, same `readServedTier` on the whole body), so every spelling that escapes the refusal also fails to stand in the guard: other case, the tier id written out, a first line naming `TIER_DEFAULT` above a second naming the contract tier, prose before the token, no line at all. I found no spelling that posts without evidence and still stands.
- `label-write.mjs --comment-file` accept set NARROWS too, and the PR does not name it: both of its `judgeBody` calls pass `{ mode: 'comment' }` with no evidence, and the file takes no evidence option, so an at-tier record can no longer be folded into a label stroke at all. Wrong as derived (the PR body says only that label-write "folds comments through the same judgeBody"); see ④ finding 3.
- `post-stamped.mjs` option set WIDENS by `--tier-evidence=PATH` (comment mode only; refused with `--body` or empty). Right.
- New module `scripts/pm/verify-review-tier.mjs` with exports `judgeReviewTranscript`, `verifyReviewTranscriptFile`, `verdictText`, `FALLBACK_NOTICE`, exit codes. Repo tooling, published by no package. Right.
- `judgeBody` is no longer pure: one file read, only when the body is an at-tier record. Its jsdoc says so. Right.
- `contract-review.md`: one rule added (two lines), the intro pointer line removed, 63 lines, at the ratchet ceiling. Right as a count; see ④ finding 2 for its content.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right: the diff touches `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` only, nothing a package publishes; `Check Changeset` is green.
Clause-②: no — agreed. No published schema or package accept set moves; the narrowing is of a seat tool.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev flag (a), is the per-turn model check enough without the fallback notice: yes, inside the card's boundary. Read against 66 real transcripts (2911 assistant entries): every assistant entry carries `message.model` and `requestedModel`, each run carries one `model` attachment, no transcript carries a `system` entry, so the notice scan is dead code today and the per-turn check is the whole instrument. Each case asked: a run that never names a model refuses (no served model); only user lines refuses (zero turns); a torn last line refuses (not JSON); a synthetic or error turn with a non-tier model value refuses, failing closed; the task folder's non-agent outputs refuse as non-JSON; the real outputs are symlinks and `readFileSync` follows them; a directory refuses on the read error, whose code alone is printed. Residuals, all nits and listed in ④: a transcript cut cleanly between turns passes on its prefix; a reviewer that delegates to its own sub-agent is judged on its own turns only; another run's transcript passes (the card gives that to the post-merge audit, #33603).
- Dev flag (b), a review run in a separate card thread: NOT answered in the tree. The PR body says the seat cannot produce evidence for it and the thread can check its own session transcript; the refusal text and the rule line say neither. Escalated as ④ finding 2.
- Dev flag (c), payment and wiring: the payment (the intro pointer line) is acceptable; `landing-operations.md` still routes to this file. The wiring claim is false in effect: `package.json` has no script naming `verify-review-tier.mjs`, no workflow names it, so `check:self-test-wired` does not count it and its 18 cases run nowhere in CI; and the post-stamped battery that is said to cover it cannot fail (④ finding 1).
- `open_questions` (wire a `check:pm-verify-review-tier` script, A leave or B follow-up): answered B, and not as a follow-up. With finding 1 fixed, A becomes defensible for the refusal's two directions, but the verifier's own 18 cases (the identity attachment, the requested model, the notice scope, the output hygiene) still run in no job. One `package.json` line plus its lint step is the seat's call to authorise on this card's surface.
- Deviation, no trailing HTML signature in the PR body: accepted; the prose signature line is present.
- Leak check: the refusal and verdict texts carry the constant's name and a line number only; the path is never echoed; `relayAction` sends `op`, `issue` and `body` and nothing from the options; `--json` output does not print the option. No model identifier in the three files (the value is imported). Clean.
- Bypass doors outside this diff, noted and not charged to this PR: a hand-written relay actions file with a `comment` op, and `comment_edit`, are judged for the signature only, so a record can reach the board without this check. Same boundary as every other post-stamped refusal; the new rule line makes using them for an at-tier record a rule breach. Carrier: #33603.

### ④ Design judgment

**1. must-fix — the new post-stamped battery cannot fail.** In `selfTest()` the battery "the record tier" was inserted AFTER the line that computes `failed` from `cases` and after the loop that prints every case (the block that opens with the comment "The floor, evaluated last"). Its 12 cases are pushed into `cases` once `failed` has already been computed, so a false assertion in any of them is neither printed nor counted: the run still ends "783 cases pass" and exits 0. Only the count floor (12 registered) binds, and it binds on running, not on holding. Deleting the `recordTierEvidenceRefusal` line from `judgeBody` would leave `check:pm-post-stamped` green. The card's item 2 asks to "pin both directions in post-stamped's self-test"; nothing is pinned, and together with flag (c) no CI job can go red on this refusal or on the verifier. Fix: move the battery above the `failed` line (beside the "review route" battery); the delta review reads that the 12 names print. The behaviour itself reads correct in the code; this finding is about the pin.

**2. should-fix — the card-thread route the same file teaches is left without a stated path.** `contract-review.md` still says the tier is taken "经子代理或卡线程取" and that a card-thread reviewer "照上落现 head 记录", and the brief template tells that reviewer to post the record itself. After this diff that post is refused, and the refusal tells it to "pass the review sub-agent's output transcript", which is not something a thread reviewer has; the new rule line names only "子代理输出". The card asked the developer to say which formats are reachable and refuse the rest; that statement exists in the PR body alone. Either the refusal text and the rule line name the thread case (the thread posts with its own session transcript as evidence, once that is measured on an at-tier main session, which the dev did not do), or they say plainly that a thread review cannot be recorded at the tier and where it goes instead. The same gap covers a review seat that reviews in its own main session.

**3. should-fix — the one-stroke record write is dead-ended with a wrong hint.** `contract-review.md` (the `needs:contract-review` section) has the seat that writes a PASS record remove the label "同笔", which is `label-write.mjs --remove ... --comment-file`. That path now always refuses an at-tier record, with a text headed "post-stamped: REFUSED" that tells the seat to pass `--tier-evidence=PATH`, an option label-write does not take. It fails closed, so no false record lands, but a taught flow breaks and the refusal misdirects. Fix one of: thread the option through label-write's two `judgeBody` calls, or make the refusal say, when `tool` is label-write, that the record goes alone through post-stamped first; and state the two-stroke order in the rule text.

**4. nit — a quoted record is treated as a record.** The marker matches a `## Contract review` heading inside a blockquote or a code fence, and "## Contract review correction" too, so a correction or adoption comment that quotes an at-tier record with its `Served-tier:` line at a line start is refused without evidence it cannot have. Consistent with the existing keyed-line refusal's scope; the workaround is to not open a line with the key. Accepted deviation.

**5. nit — verifier residuals.** `advisorModel` (present on every assistant entry, equal to the served model in all 2911 read) is not compared; a model value carrying a context suffix would refuse an at-tier run (not seen in the sample); nested sub-agents are not followed; a cleanly truncated prefix passes. None changes the honest-failure boundary the card sets. Follow-up under #33603 if wanted.

**6. nit — stale comments.** After the fix in 1 the "floor, evaluated last" comment is true again; label-write's header list of what `judgeBody` judges does not mention the tier check (outside this diff).

The verifier (`judgeReviewTranscript`) agrees with the card's item 1 sentence by sentence: tier imported from `dispatch-gates.mjs` and never respelled, every served and requested model and the identity attachment compared exactly, unreadable, empty and unparsable refuse with a reason, self-test pins the four cases the card names, floors and the verdict handshake are present.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-f3mcct`
Reviewed-by: `session_01FEkQ5pjSPT7ui2EUcunaVb`

**VERDICT: FAIL**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `bd90104a2041ea42c2398c49b11bd16d48d4c680`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md + scripts/pm/verify-review-tier.mjs, scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs (the `--tier-evidence` refusal and its battery), scripts/pm/label-write.mjs (the `--tier-evidence` fold and its battery)

Delta review. Base: `97bbc81dfa9e`, whose record 6888257144 is FAIL (must-fix 1, should-fix 2 and 3, nits 4 to 6). Three developer commits since (`0dc1a041`, `e3f0c988`, `bd90104a`), no main merge. Inputs read: card #33605 body and both comments; PR #33616 body, file list (4 files) and the base record; the diff base to head and the net diff against `main`; the check-runs on this head and the log of the job that runs `check:pm-post-stamped`. Code outside the diff was read, not reviewed: `invoked-as.mjs`, `record-recognisers.mjs` (the template text), `package.json`, `lint.yml`, `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`. For shape only, and never run through the PR's script: the seat's sub-agent transcripts in its task folder and a type-and-field census of the seat's own session transcript (entry kinds, which fields carry a model, where the fallback wording occurs).

Check-runs on this head: all 48 completed, 26 success, 22 skipped by design (`Check Changeset` among them, on the `skip-changeset` label). None red, none still running.

### ① Derived judgments

- `label-write.mjs` option set WIDENS by `--tier-evidence PATH` (both spellings parse), accepted only beside `--comment-file`, refused alone and refused empty. Right.
- `label-write.mjs --comment-file` accept set: the narrowing the base record named as wrong is repaired. An at-tier record folds again, on evidence that passes; without it, or on a transcript that refuses, exit 2 and zero sends. Both `judgeBody` calls (the fold and `composeReleaseBody`) carry the option. Right.
- `post-stamped.mjs`: `recordTierEvidenceRefusalText` gains a second parameter naming the sender; `judgeBody` passes its own `tool`. Its accept set is unchanged from the base. Right.
- `verify-review-tier.mjs`: `judgeReviewTranscript` is byte-for-byte the base's. The session transcript was already accepted by the code; this head documents it and pins it (one pass case, one refuse case). No accept-set change. Right.
- Self-test floors move with the cases: the record-tier battery 12 to 15, label-write's fold battery 24 to 28, the verifier's first two batteries 3 to 4 and 4 to 5. Counted against the code: 15, 4 new, 20 total. Right.
- `contract-review.md`: the two Served-tier bullets become one, 63 lines, at the ratchet ceiling of 63. Dropped against the base: the `--face declaration` hint and the clause that a brief's self-description does not count. Right; see ④.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right: `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` only, published by no package.
Clause-②: no — agreed. No published schema or package accept set moves.

### ③ Boundary flags

- M1 (base finding 1): closed. See ④.
- SF-1 (base finding 2, dev flag b): closed. See ④.
- SF-2 (base finding 3): closed. See ④.
- Dev flag (c) and the `open_questions` entry (wire the verifier's self-test): answered by another route than the base record proposed. No `package.json` line was added; post-stamped's self-test spawns the verifier's and counts its exit and success line, so the verifier's 20 cases now run inside `check:pm-post-stamped`. The job log on this head shows that case and the 786-case verdict. Accepted.
- Leak check on the delta: the refusal now interpolates the sender name (`post-stamped` or `label-write`) and names the generic location `~/.claude/projects/`; it carries no evidence path and no model identifier, and the no-leak case now also requires each of its three rows to be a refusal. label-write's dry-run prints the packed payload, which holds the comment body and the label ops and nothing from the option. Clean.
- The PR body still describes the base (3 files, 783 cases, sub-agent evidence only). Judged on the tree; listed as a nit in ④.

### ④ Design judgment

**Base finding 1 (must-fix), CLOSED.** The record-tier battery now sits above the line that computes `failed` and above the loop that prints the cases, so a false case in it is printed and counted; the floor block follows it. The spawn of the verifier's self-test reads sound: the running node binary, the verifier's path resolved from the module URL (so the working directory does not matter), the environment inherited, and the case requires BOTH exit 0 and the verifier's own success line, so a child that did nothing cannot pass it. `invoked-as.mjs` makes the child a real entrypoint under a symlinked checkout too. The CI log on this head carries the case as passed.

**Base finding 2 (should-fix), CLOSED.** The refusal, the usage text, the verifier's header and the rule line all name the second evidence path: the reviewing session's own transcript, which passes only when every assistant turn of the whole session is at the tier. Tried against it, by reading:
- earlier turns at the tier and the review turns elsewhere, or the reverse: refused at the first off-tier line. The text says every turn, so the reviewer knows a mixed session cannot be evidence and reruns.
- zero assistant turns after the other kinds are skipped: refused (the turn count is checked at the end).
- a `system` entry carrying the fallback wording: refused, as before.
- does skipping the model-less kinds open a hole: no. In the real session transcript read for shape, every one of its assistant entries carries both the served and the requested model, the run's identity attachment recurs after each restart and is compared each time, and the fallback wording occurs only in tool results, tool calls and attachments (a memory note and file reads), never in a `system` entry. The per-turn check is the whole instrument and it is unchanged.
- a session transcript containing a sub-agent's turns: it does not. Sub-agent turns live in their own files; the session file holds none. See nit 7.
- `contract-review.md`: the text matches the code, both writers take the option, and `--face declaration` is taught by the `--template` output on `main`. The card's item 3 (explicit model on the Agent call; post only through the evidence check) is still stated.

**Base finding 3 (should-fix), CLOSED.** label-write takes the option, passes it to both `judgeBody` calls, refuses it alone or empty, and the refusal opens with `label-write: REFUSED` and tells the seat to pass the option on this label-write call. The at-tier case sends the record and the `needs:contract-review` removal in one dispatch; the bare and off-tier cases send nothing. The structural pins in both self-tests were updated to the new call shape, so they still bind.

**Base nit 6, CLOSED.** The floor comment is true again; label-write's header names the tier check.

New on this head, all nits:

**7. nit — a session's transcript says nothing about a review it delegated.** A session at the tier that hands the review to its own sub-agent, and then passes its session transcript, passes whatever served the sub-agent: the sub-agent's turns are not in the session file, and a sub-agent's fallback notice reaches the parent as a user or attachment entry, which is deliberately not scanned. The refusal text confines the session path to "a review this session ran itself"; the rule line says "卡线程或席内复核", which is looser. This is the card's stated boundary (another run's transcript), not a new hole. Follow-up under #33603; a tighter word in the rule line would be a head move.

**8. nit — the verifier's header understates the session shape.** It lists four extra entry kinds and says none carries a model. The real session transcript has more kinds, and its cost summary entries carry a per-model usage map. The code is right to skip them (they are not turns); only the comment is inexact. Accepted deviation.

**9. nit — the rule line's file name placeholder.** The session transcript is named by the local transcript id, not by the `session_` id seats sign with; a reader may look for the wrong name. The refusal text (SESSION.jsonl under the projects folder) is enough to find it. Accepted deviation.

**10. nit — the spawn has no timeout and drops the child's failure lines.** The verifier's self-test does no I/O beyond one missing-file read, so a hang is not realistic; on a failure the post-stamped case names itself but not the verifier case that failed. Accepted deviation.

**11. nit — the PR body is stale (prose face).** It names 3 files, the old case counts and sub-agent evidence only. Fixable in the body without moving the head: add `label-write.mjs`, the session evidence path and the spawn.

Carried from the base record, unchanged: nit 4 (a quoted record is read as a record, accepted) and nit 5 (verifier residuals, #33603).

No regression found across the scope. No model identifier and no evidence path in any text the tools post.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-f3mcct`
Reviewed-by: `session_01FEkQ5pjSPT7ui2EUcunaVb`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `2f8c4e024c0ee4c945f74ebc47c86995e84182ab`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md + scripts/pm/verify-review-tier.mjs, scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs (the `--tier-evidence` refusal and its battery), scripts/pm/label-write.mjs (the `--tier-evidence` fold and its battery)

Delta review of a main merge. Base: `bd90104a2041`, whose record 6888534276 is PASS (nits 7 to 10 carried to #33603, nit 11 on the PR body). The head is a merge commit with two parents, `bd90104a2041` and main at `41b64bb08cfe` (PR #33510); no developer commit beside it. Inputs read: card #33605 body and both comments; PR #33616 body, file list and the base record; the diff base to head, the net diff against the new merge base, and the check-runs on this head. Code outside the diff was read, not reviewed: `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`, `close-cards.mjs`, `first-touch-sweep.mjs`, `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, `landing-operations.md`, `package.json`. Nothing was built or run; the one git plumbing read below writes no worktree.

Check-runs on this head: all 44 completed, 25 success, 19 skipped by design (`Check Changeset` among them, on `skip-changeset`). None red, none still running. `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests` and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` are green.

### ① Derived judgments

- The merge is mechanical. The head's tree is identical to the tree git's own three-way merge of the two parents writes (same tree id), so the merge commit holds no hand edit. Right.
- Net diff against the new merge base `41b64bb08cfe`: exactly 4 files, +430 / -21, the same four as the base. For `contract-review.md`, `post-stamped.mjs` and `verify-review-tier.mjs` the changed lines are identical to the base's net diff. Right.
- `label-write.mjs`: the PR side still changes 43 added / 10 removed lines, the same hunks as the base, now applied on top of #33510's 138 lines. No accept-set change on the PR's side from the merge. Right.
- #33510's accept-set change in `label-write.mjs` (the stateless-write refusal at step ② of the plain write, the fold and `--release`) is main's, already landed, and not this PR's to judge; it only narrows what reaches the comment judge. Right.
- Battery ledgers: label-write's roster declares 16 batteries against `SELF_TEST_BATTERY_FLOOR = 16` (main's new stateless battery at 19, the PR's fold battery at 28). Both sides count. Right.
- `contract-review.md` is 63 lines against the ratchet's ceiling of 63, which #33510's edit to the ratchet file left untouched for this row. Right.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right: `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` only, published by no package.
Clause-②: no — agreed. No published schema or package accept set moves.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev flags (a), (b), (c) and the `open_questions` entry were answered on the base record and nothing in this merge reopens them: the verifier, post-stamped and the rule line are byte-identical on the PR's side, and `package.json` still runs `check:pm-post-stamped` and `check:pm-label-write` as before.
- The developer's report of a textually clean merge is confirmed against the tree, not taken on trust (① first bullet).
- Main has moved four commits past `41b64bb08cfe` since the merge; none touches `scripts/pm/**` or `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`. The record covers this head only.

### ④ Design judgment

**(1) Merged `label-write.mjs`: the state guard and the tier fold coexist.** Read in the head's tree:
- `runLabelWrite` asks `refuseStatelessWrite` on step ①'s read, then hands a `--comment-file` stroke to `foldStroke`, which still calls `judgeBody(text, { mode: 'comment', tierEvidence: options.tierEvidence }, …, 'label-write')`. A stroke the state guard refuses returns before any body is judged or sent, so the order opens nothing.
- `runRelease` asks the state guard, then reads the file and calls `composeReleaseBody` with `tierEvidence: options.tierEvidence`, which passes it to `judgeBody`. Same order, same result.
- #33510 added NO path that posts a comment body in this file: its hunks are the predicate, its constants, the two guard calls, a battery and one fixture label swap. The file holds exactly two `judgeBody` calls and both carry the evidence. The two structural pins that bind the call shapes are the PR's updated ones and still match the merged source.
- The PR's at-tier fold cases target a pull request (`kind: 'pull'`) removing `needs:contract-review`; the state guard never judges a pull and that label is not a pm state, so main's guard cannot turn those cases. A verdict fold on an issue card that moves no pm state and no assignee passes the guard too. Tried: a record fold that also strips the card's last pm state is refused at ② with zero writes, which is main's rule and not an unverified post.
- The PR's new `import { CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER } from './dispatch-gates.mjs'` sits beside main's widened label-write and dispatch import cycle; the constant is used only inside the self-test, never at module scope, and the green self-test jobs on this head show both entrypoints load.

**(2) Other files #33510 changed that this PR's code reads.**
- `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`: the five names post-stamped imports (`EXIT_UNCONFIRMED`, `packRequest`, `resolveRoute`, `sendFleetWrite`, `unconfirmedText`) are untouched. The new code is the state guard only (`stateGuardRows`, `judgeStateGuard`, `readStateGuard`, their CLI block and battery); it reads labels and assignees, and adds or changes no comment op.
- `close-cards.mjs` gains one guard line and one case; `first-touch-sweep.mjs` (new) reads and prints, it writes no comment.
- `dispatch-gates.mjs`, `record-recognisers.mjs`, `check-half-states.mjs`, `invoked-as.mjs`, `fleet-write/ops.mjs`, `fleet-write/validate.mjs`, `write-pace.mjs`, `package.json` and the workflows are unchanged between base and head.
- So the tier refusal sits where the PR claims it: post-stamped's `--comment` and label-write's fold and `--release`. The raw actions-file door of `dispatch.mjs` (a `comment` or `comment_edit` op handed to it directly) is not judged for tier, exactly as on the base and on main; it is the residual the base record already carries (nit 5, #33603), not something this merge opened.

**(3) Net diff.** Still the 4 files, see ①.

**(4) Regression.** None found. `contract-review.md` reads as on the base; `landing-operations.md`, which the deleted intro line pointed to, still routes here.

New on this head, nit only:

**12. nit — the PR body's numbers are the base's (prose face).** It names head `bd90104a` in its verification blocks, 207 label-write cases (main's battery adds to that), and `landing-operations.md` lines 13 and 77; after #33510 the second route is line 78. Fixable in the body without moving the head, together with nit 11.

Carried unchanged: nits 4, 5, 7 to 11 as on record 6888534276.

No model identifier and no evidence path in any text the tools post; the merge touched none of those strings.
